purpose: Research registry of external G2P/IPA comparator systems and IPA/source-script display fonts. Entries are not active runtime dependencies; system smoke results are not pronunciation gold data.

integration_contract.pipeline: source orthography -> language-specific structural/phonological analysis -> typed IPA result -> ClippyFirst IPA-to-Ukrainian adapter -> practical Ukrainian orthography
prohibited: silently rewriting external output into IPA without a documented conversion
using unverified output as gold data

candidates.name: BYU MATRIX MekongPhon Khmer IPA model
candidates.output: 33.6M-parameter BERT encoder-decoder; model card's examples output IPA-like strings; pinned HF revision 20e069d384b240da76320e1569958568c12a54bc. Paper reports under 2% CER on its own held-out test setup. Added as optional benchmark target; project run pending; MekongPhon corpus-data rights remain unresolved.
candidates.license: Model card declares Apache-2.0; training corpus license is not declared in the MekongPhon repository snapshot; do not redistribute corpus data or assume the model license clears source data.

candidates.name: MekongPhon rule-based Khmer→IPA baseline
candidates.output: Separate experimental baseline with consonant/register and vowel assignment tables plus khmer-nltk tokenization; not the published neural model. Not executed in this pass; inspect conventions and exact dependency/license before use.
candidates.license: MekongPhon snapshot has no declared root LICENSE; do not copy or redistribute code/data pending clarification.

candidates.name: PhonSobon Khmer G2P (NCKL respelling)
candidates.kind: character-level Khmer pronunciation respeller and syllabifier (not IPA)
candidates.output: 7.46M-parameter character Transformer maps Khmer words to NCKL Khmer-script respelling with hyphenated syllable boundaries. Model card reports 83.37% validation word accuracy at epoch 150; no test score reported there. Output is not IPA and must never enter the IPA→Ukrainian adapter.
candidates.license: Model card declares MIT. Separate dataset phonsobon/khmer-G2P derives from the NCKL Khmer Dictionary 2022; dataset card says check NCKL terms before commercial use; dataset rights are unresolved.

candidates.name: PhonSobon NCKL Khmer G2P dataset
candidates.kind: Khmer-script pronunciation and syllabification benchmark resource (not IPA)
candidates.output: 38,629 word→Khmer-script respelling pairs, 37,755 unique words; train 34,770, validation 1,939, test 1,920 with all readings of a word kept in one split. Standard NCKL/Phnom Penh prescribed word pronunciations; no IPA, no sentence-level sandhi. Useful for orthography-to-respelling and syllable-boundary evaluation only.
candidates.license: Dataset card attributes content to NCKL Khmer Dictionary 2022 and explicitly asks users to check NCKL terms before commercial use; do not redistribute or use commercially without rights clarification.

benchmark_protocol.scoring_gate: Only independently adjudicated, non-empty gold_ipa rows are scored.
benchmark_protocol.notes: Registry membership does not establish language support, IPA output semantics, reproducibility, accuracy, or license compatibility. Preserve raw output and record exact versions and model/data licenses.

observed_experiments.interpretation: The source-attested entries are explicitly not independently adjudicated gold; output symbols must be checked against this project's IPA convention.

observed_experiments.notes: 6 raw outputs. Output is a list of phone tokens. Source-attested IPA comparison is not scored; e.g. stress/syllable separators in `ភ្នំពេញ` are not represented in token output, but this is a convention difference to review, not automatically a phonological error.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream describes MIT-licensed standalone Khmer G2P and returns word tokens plus phoneme tokens.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Some phone sequences may be IPA-like; do not assume full convention parity or lexical accuracy.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream describes a 29,204-entry IPA pronunciation dictionary validated by native linguists; README says dictionary data is CC BY-SA 4.0, distinct from MIT code/model.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Not integrated or redistributed. Need inspect exact release/files, dialect/annotation convention and licensing before use.

upstream_evidence.engine: BYU MATRIX MekongPhon Khmer IPA model
upstream_evidence.fact: Model card declares Apache-2.0, 33.6M-parameter BERT encoder-decoder, separate Khmer/IPA tokenizers and a pinned usable API; paper is LREC 2026 and reports under 2% CER in its own held-out setup.
upstream_evidence.caveat: The MekongPhon data repository snapshot has no declared root license; the model card's Apache-2.0 tag does not resolve source corpus rights. Its evaluation references are source-reported and not this project's independent gold. This project's 100-row run measured 64/100 strict source-attested matches and 12.539% codepoint CER on the pinned pron_no_tones split; this does not reproduce the paper's under-2% claim and the evaluation setups must not be conflated.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream contains an experimental rule-based baseline with consonant/vowel assignments and Khmer tokenization.
upstream_evidence.caveat: No root LICENSE is declared in the inspected snapshot; output convention and coverage have not been validated.

upstream_evidence.fact: Model card declares MIT and describes a 7.46M-parameter Transformer that predicts NCKL Khmer-script respelling with syllable separators; reports 83.37% validation word accuracy.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Not IPA; dataset is derived from NCKL Khmer Dictionary 2022 and its card asks users to check NCKL terms before commercial use. Validation score is self-reported, not a project benchmark.

scope_note: Historical filename: this registry catalogs both external G2P/IPA comparison systems and display fonts. Fonts are rendering assets, not pronunciation engines.

status_semantics.verified_in_repo: true means the candidate's pronunciation behavior has been validated against project-approved independent gold. A successful smoke or upstream language-support claim does not set this flag.
status_semantics.execution_status: Records whether a candidate was run, blocked, or only reported upstream; it is independent of verified_in_repo.
